t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are sets of knomes that come in pairs and one of the two has a higher value than the other. This however can change throughtout the game.

vb_textbox.text: There are several pairs of gnomes which come in coloured pairs like red and yellow, purple and brown.  Each set have a different value of mushroomes which they can help you find.  Due to the speed of time (1.5 seconds) in which you have to choose the gnome you believe will yield the best result it's difficult to dissern which one garners the best result. But the primary red, pink, green and blue seem to have the best results.
